Generate ONE arcane projectile first-flight frame with generous black margins on a square1024x1024 canvas. This is the third native attempt: position is critical.

REFERENCE1 is the APPROVED radiant orb. Copy ONLY its ORB CENTER POSITION: its white core sits in the exact center of the canvas. REFERENCE2 is the arcane design to reconstruct at that centered position: replace radiant body with a SMALL compact white bright core, ONE thin CIRCULAR ring around it with four tiny abstract circular glyph marks, and wispy smoky ribbons trailing to the LEFT for rightward flight. Reference2 core is too far right: DO NOT COPY ITS POSITION. REFERENCE3 is the approved painted white-core/gray falloff style.

The core and circular ring MUST be centered at EXACT50 percent width and50 percent height, aligned with the core position of reference1. Draw the ring around the canvas center, then a white core at its center, then add trailing smoke asymmetrically on the LEFT. The whole smoke-plus-orb bounding box WILL be left of canvas center; do not recenter that box. The ring is small and circular, no ellipse or perspective. White/gray only, flat overhead ground-plane drawing, pure black background. Dense compact white core surrounded by black space inside the thin ring, small circles as glyphs only. No readable letters, no scene, no people, no hands, no weapon, no border, no shadows. Preserve the arcane identity of reference2 but use the centered position of reference1. All pixels/glow within frame. Only this single first flight frame, no other phases or montage.

A single frame of a 2D game visual effect, pure top-down view as if lying flat on the ground, no perspective. Pure black background (#000000), nothing else in the image: no character, no weapon, no hand, no text, no border, no shadow, no ground. The effect is neutral white and light gray only (no color, any motif such as flames or rays is drawn in white and gray), with soft glowing edges so it can be tinted and blended additively in the game. Square 1024x1024 canvas, the origin point of the effect at the exact center of the image. The effect points to the RIGHT, maximum reach about 45 percent of the image width from the center. Clean stylized hand-painted look with sharp bright core and soft falloff, readable at small size. Subject: a swirling arcane orb: a small dense bright core inside a thin rotating ring with tiny circular glyph marks on the ring, and a wispy smoky trail pointing LEFT because it flies to the RIGHT. Frame 2 of 8, fly 01: flight frame 2 of 4: the same projectile, its glow pulsing slightly brighter and the tail flickering a little longer. Match exactly the line style, glow, thickness and shape of the approved gate frame attached.
